content_sections.heading: KGBV Agra Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 34 vacancies are available - 4 for Full Time Teacher (Maths), 2 for Full Time Teacher (Biology), 2 for Full Time Teacher (English), 3 for Accountant, 2 for Part Time Teacher (Physical Education), 2 for Part Time Teacher (Art Craft Music/ Home Science), 5 for Part Time Teacher (Computer), 1 for Cook, 10 for Assistant Cook, 2 for Peon, and 1 for Watchman.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for KGBV Agra Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: agra.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas Agra, commonly known as KGBV Agra. It is a government educational institution.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 34 vacancies available for various teaching and non-teaching posts under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their application forms is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for these positions must be between 25 and 45 years of age. Age will be calculated as on 01 April 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for KGBV Agra posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the various posts ranges from Rs. 5978/- to Rs. 25410/- per month, depending on the specific position.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. It is completely free to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for more details?
faq.answer: For more details and to download the application form, candidates should visit the official website agra.nic.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for KGBV Agra recruitment involves application screening followed by document verification of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What are the qualifications required for Full Time Teacher (Maths)?
faq.answer: For Full Time Teacher (Maths), candidates must be a Trained Graduate from the PCM group and possess a TET qualification at the UP level.
